info.title: Subtitle Edit Converter API
info.description: Convert subtitles between text and binary broadcast formats (EBU STL, PAC, Cavena 890, ...) with Subtitle Edit's libse. Errors are RFC 7807 problem+json with a stable `code`, a `hint` and the `requestId`. Send `Authorization: Bearer <key>` when API keys are configured.

get.summary: Get retained job metadata, never subtitle content.

post.description: Upload `file` with `preset`, `target` and/or `profile` (JSON overrides). Response headers report detected format/encoding, cue counts and warnings.

parameters.name: X-Request-Id
parameters.description: Optional client request id, echoed back; replaced by a fresh ULID when it doesn't match the pattern.

parameters.name: Prefer
parameters.description: wait=N, from 0 to 60 seconds; default configured wait is 30. wait=0 returns 202 immediately.

input.description: Storage URI; mutually exclusive with file.

output.description: Exact output URI; omit to receive converted bytes.

sidecar.description: true | false (default false), write output.json beside output.

target.description: Target format id/alias; shorthand for profile.target.format.

profile.description: Profile JSON (full profile or overrides on top of preset). Schema: GET /v1/schemas/profile.json.

X-Request-Id.description: Request id (also in problem.requestId and the logs).

X-Job-Id.description: Job id; GET /v1/jobs/{id} retrieves metadata while retained.

X-Detected-Format.description: Detected (or forced) source format id; single input only.

X-Detected-Encoding.description: Detected text encoding, or `binary` for binary input.

X-Detected-Code-Page.description: Binary input only: EBU GSI code page (e.g. 850) or pac-<name>.

X-Warnings.description: Warnings as compact JSON with code, message and count only (ASCII, truncated to 4 KB); hint and details are in the JSON body.

X-Verification-Verdict.description: Single binary output only: read-back verdict lossless | quantised | lossy | unverified (details in the JSON response's outputs[].verification).

X-Profile.description: Preset name, when one was used.

202.description: Still running; poll Location. Jobs retain metadata, not subtitle bytes.

post.summary: Convert subtitle content sent as JSON (for agents).
post.description: Send `content` as text (or base64 with contentEncoding=base64; binary formats such as EBU STL must be base64). Outputs come back as text for Unicode encodings, base64 otherwise; binary targets are always base64.

get.description: Use `id` or an alias as source/target format. `textOnly` defaults to true (text formats only, as in earlier versions). `kind` is a comma list of text|binary|image|container and wins over `textOnly`; image/container formats are listed only via `kind` and can't be converted. `writable=true` keeps formats that can be a target.

post.summary: Detect the format and encoding of a subtitle.
post.description: Send multipart `file`, or JSON {content, contentEncoding, fileName} (binary files as base64). Returns `kind`, `codePage` for binary input and up to 5 `candidates`. 422 format-not-detected when nothing matches.

type.description: URL of the code's section in docs/errors.md.

debug.description: Diagnostics, only when ERRORS_VERBOSE=true. Never contains file content.

phase.description: conversion-timeout only: queue is retryable like 503.

candidates.description: ambiguous-format only: the format ids the bytes match; set profile.source.format to one of them.

ApiProblem.description: RFC 7807 problem details with a stable `code` (docs/errors.md). Extra members may appear: `phase` (conversion-timeout: queue|running), `candidates` (ambiguous-format).

FieldError.description: A problem located by a JSON pointer (profile field, query parameter, ...).

bearer.description: API key as a bearer token. Required only when the server has API_KEYS/API_KEYS_FILE set (GET /v1/limits → auth.required).
